messages:
Maria G: Quick proposal: gate inbound handoff until enrichment returns email_verified OR match_score >= 0.8 for a canary subset. Goal = fewer noisy claims.
Sam K: Sounds promising. What's the canary % / timeout?
Maria G: Start 10% canary, hold up to 30m while we try enrichment. If still missing, fall back to normal round-robin. Keep 90% unchanged.
Jordan: Watch out for duplicate assignments in HubSpot workflows 94 we saw that bug last quarter when reassign triggers fired twice.
Ana P: We can add an idempotency key on our assign webhook that checks last_owner_change_ts; if match, skip. Also add a HS contact property "lead_hold_reason" = "enrichment_canary".
Sam K: Good. SDRs should see a pinned note so they know why a lead is delayed. I'll draft a short playbook message.
Alex T: From infra: add debounce 2s + 3 retries for enrichment calls. Also attach header X-Lead-Canary: true for easy log filtering.
Maria G: Metrics: claim_rate, avg_time_to_claim, enrichment_success_within_30m, assigned_without_enrich_pct, SDR_spam_rate. Need dashboard and alerts.
Jordan: I'll create a Grafana panel and alert if assigned_without_enrich_pct > 5% during canary.
Ana P: Also capture manual_touch_pct for leads that never enrich.
Sam K: Rollout plan: 10% for 48h -> review statistics + SDR feedback -> 25% for 7d -> full. Require sales-ops signoff before 25%.
Maria G: Owners: Jordan (dashboards/alerts), Alex T (debounce/retries + header), Ana P (idempotency + HS field), Sam K (SDR comms). I'll write the one-pager and HS workflow JSON.
Maria G: HS workflow draft snippet: {"workflow":"hold-and-check","conditions":["email_verified==true","match_score>=0.8"],"action":"assign_or_delay(30m)"}
Alex T: Deploy tag and logs look good; add a kill-switch flag in feature flags if latency spikes.
DeployBot: deploy queued: feature/lead-enrich-hold -> staging (sha: a1b2c3)
Maria G: Collect SDR feedback after 24h and reconvene. Sam, can you set a 30-min check-in tomorrow 10am PT?
Sam K: Done. I'll post the playbook in #marketing and ping sales-ops.
DeployBot: deploy success: feature/lead-enrich-hold -> staging (sha: a1b2c3) at 3321088000
Maria G: Thanks everyone. We'll iterate after canary metrics come in.
